R1_3.evidence: Looked for deposit-level standards (DataCite/Dublin Core metadata, domain schemas, accredited-repository ingest); none applies - there are no deposits. Methodological rigour of morphometric protocols does not qualify under the v2.1 R1.3 boundary.
